answer: The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own jetty record, and its own share of the sable quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The spiral ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 3147 identities would post 2379 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
